name: ❓ Question & Support
description: Ask a question about Śiṣya Abhyāsa usage, deployment, or architecture.
title: "[QUESTION]: "
labels: ["question"]
assignees: []
body:
  - type: textarea
    id: question
    attributes:
      label: Your Question
      description: What would you like to ask or clarify?
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: textarea
    id: context
    attributes:
      label: Additional Context
      description: Add any relevant background context, links, or logs.
